info.title: ChuckData

get.description: All matching notes as one Markdown file, oldest first. Takes the same filters as ListNotes; paging is ignored.

Serves a file, or its preview with thumb=true. Supports Range (206) and conditional (304) requests. The response is
cacheable for a long time only when v matches the attachment's current version.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: The attachment's version, from its JSON.

schema.description: The attachment's version, from its JSON.

put.description: The body is a small preview image (at most 1024 pixels on each side) made by the client.

get.description: Newest first; open todos come first. Supports full-text search, a tag, a date range and paging.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search (prefix match on each word).

schema.description: Free-text search (prefix match on each word).

parameters.name: media
parameters.description: Set when files will be uploaded next, so the card may start without text.

schema.description: Set when files will be uploaded next, so the card may start without text.

post.description:
The body is the raw file (image, or WebM, Ogg, M4A, MP3 or WAV audio). The type is detected from the bytes and
location metadata is stripped before storing.

parameters.name: duration_ms
parameters.description: Audio length measured by the browser, 0 to 6 hours (display only).

schema.description: Audio length measured by the browser, 0 to 6 hours (display only).

post.description: Puts a card between two neighbours. At least one of prev and next is required. Open todos stay above other cards.
Applies every rule to the caller's existing notes.
Suggests tags for text being written, from the caller's own tagged notes.

changed.description: Number of notes whose tags changed.

duration_ms.description: Audio length as measured by the uploading browser (display only).

v.description: Changes whenever the file or its preview changes; put it in the media URL so caches never show a stale file.

ConflictResponseContent.description:
The data changed meanwhile (for example the card was removed while saving), or the account is in a state that forbids the
action. Look again and retry.

prev.description: The card that will be directly above this one, or absent for the top of its group.

next.description: The card that will be directly below this one, or absent for the bottom.

remind_at.description: Next time the reminder is due.

due_at.description: Due date of a todo card.

pattern.description: Keywords separated by `|` or `,`; the rule fires if any appears (case-insensitive).

confidence.description: Estimated probability (0 to 1) that the tag fits.
The confidence that was shown for the suggestion.

tagged_notes.description: Notes with at least one tag the user wrote: what the model learned from.
